refnamediv.refpurpose: Return a simulation of the ARMA model.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: x = arma_rnd(a, b, v, t, n) x = arma_rnd(a, b, v, t)

listitem.para: Real vector. Coefficients of the autoregressive (AR) part of the model.
Real vector. Coefficients of the moving average (MA) part of the model.
Variance of the Gaussian white noise.
Number of dummy x(i) used for initialization (optional, default = 100).

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The ARMA model is defined by: x(n) = a(1) * x(n-1) + … + a(k) * x(n-k) + e(n) + b(1) * e(n-1) + … + b(l) * e(n-l), where `k` is the length of vector `a`, `l` is the length of vector `b`, and `e` is Gaussian white noise with variance `v`. The function returns a vector of length `t`. The optional parameter `n` specifies the number of dummy x(i) used for initialization. If `n` is omitted, it defaults to 100.
